infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SportnNote uses the microphone for hands-free voice scoring. Audio isn’t recorded or uploaded by SportnNote — only the recognized words are used.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SportnNote uses speech recognition to turn your spoken calls (like “goal Rao”) into score entries.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow SportnNote to open your contacts so you can pick a player’s mobile number. Only the contact you pick is used.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SportnNote to use the camera to scan a team invite QR code.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow SportnNote to open your contacts so you can pick a player’s mobile number. Only the contact you pick is used.

plugins.microphonePermission: SportnNote uses the microphone for hands-free voice scoring. Audio isn’t recorded or uploaded by SportnNote — only the recognized words are used.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: SportnNote uses speech recognition to turn your spoken calls (like “goal Rao”) into score entries.
